decisions.reason: After four years and two years without website visibility, this narrow net-price display plugin appears to have yielded enough information to show limited standalone value, so the option is no longer worth keeping open.
Despite the missing website mentions, the ERP interface plugin remains strategically complementary to the firm's multichannel direction and can still justify a low-cost wait-and-see commitment.
With several similar price-comparison tracking options in the portfolio and no visibility since 2019, the learning phase is effectively over and this overlapping plugin should be abandoned.
This second price-comparison tracking plugin faces the same overlap and weak market signal as the others, making further maintenance hard to justify relative to reallocating resources.
The net-price reporting plugin is close to the firm's capabilities but its prolonged absence from the website suggests modest demand, so management would likely end it as a standalone product.
